name: TERRACE
description: Terrace is a two-deck solitaire for one player. Shuffle two decks; 11 cards face-up reserve, 8 foundation piles, 9 tableau piles. Deal 3 to three tableaus, choose one for first foundation (only that rank to foundations). Build foundations up in alternating colours (A between K and 2); tableaus down in alternating colours. Reserve: only top card to foundations. Empty tableau filled from stock or discard. Goal: move all 104 cards to foundations.

Family: Terrace. Categories: Thinker's, Rewarding, Two-Deck, Large. Also known as Queen of Italy; origin inferred from alias. No detailed timeline documented in primary source.
One player. Terrace is a solitaire (two-deck patience) for a single player.
Two standard 52-card decks shuffled together (104 cards).
Two decks, table space for reserve, eight foundations, nine tableaus, stock and discard.

Shuffle both decks. Lay 11 cards face-up in a row as the reserve. Below, eight empty foundation piles and nine empty tableau piles. Deal three cards from stock face-up, one to each of three tableaus. Choose one of these three to move to the first foundation; only cards of that rank may start other empty foundations. Deal seven more cards from stock, one onto each remaining empty tableau. Remaining cards form the stock (face-up, squared). Discard pile starts empty.
